newsitem.title: GREECE: Weakness may lead Greek shares to 1450-tech.anals.
newsitem.headline: Weakness may lead Greek shares to 1450-tech.anals.

text.p: The stock market's recent weakness could force the benchmark share index down to a support level of 1,450 points, said technical analyst Nick Kostopoulos at Commercial Securities.

Kostopoulos, who had given a bearish technical signal last week noting the market's fatigue and moderating trading volume, said the retreat had broken the long term upward trend line on the downside and a significant upward move was unlikely in the short term.

"The market will meet strong support at 1,450 points and will be in for sideways movement for a while. Selective buying should be considered at the 1,500-1,540 level for investors with a medium term view," he said.
But cash reserves should be put aside to be used for buying at the area of 1,450 points, he added.
Stocks were down 2.56 percent, 39.5 points, in mid-session Friday with the benchmark index at 1,503 points. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
